```{r}
penguins |> mutate(flipper_class =case_when(flipper_len < 190 ~ "short", flipper_len <= 210 ~ "medium", TRUE ~ "long")) |> distinct(species, flipper_class)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, mapping = aes(x = bill_len, y = bill_dep)) + geom_point()
```

```{r}
penguins |> mutate(size = case_when(flipper_len > 210 & body_mass > 4500 ~ "big", flipper_len < 190 & body_mass < 3500 ~ "small", TRUE ~ "medium")) |> ggplot(mapping = aes(x = flipper_len, y = body_mass, colour = size)) + geom_point()
```

```{r}
penguins |> rename(f_len = flipper_len|> head())
```

```{r}
penguins |> group_by(species, island) |> summarize(mean_body_mass = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
penguins |> group_by(species, island) |> filter(body_mass == max(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE))
```
